found_by: the in-process fuzzer, read-only mode, first 60-second campaign, unplanted
base: Tests/fuzz/make_seeds.sh seed s01 as it stood then (ext4, 1 KiB blocks, metadata_csum, 3 MiB)
minimization: libFuzzer's -minimize_crash got nowhere on a structured 3 MiB image ('failed to minimize beyond 3145728 bytes'). Delta-debugging the diff against the seed took it from 4996 bytes in 1664 runs to four bytes in one.

edits.what: inode 14, byte offset 3: i_uid's high byte and the low three bytes of i_size_lo
edits.effect: a one-block directory becomes one claiming ~16 MB on a 3 MiB volume

symptom: ext4_extent_get_blocks returns EOK with fblock 0 for a logical block the tree does not map; the directory walk passes support_unwritten = false, and ext4_assert(*fblock || support_unwritten) aborted. CONFIG_DEBUG_ASSERT ships, so on the installed extension this is a corrupt directory taking the mount down from an `ls`.
note: The inode checksum is left wrong on purpose -- lwext4 warns and continues, which is its own observation about how far a bad inode gets.
